## Summary

Built a complete open-source micro-services platform from scratch in a single session.

## What Was Built

### Repositories
| Repo | URL | Description |
|------|-----|-------------|
| `pokelabshq/council` | https://github.com/pokelabshq/council | Micro-services + gateway |
| `pokelabshq/poke` | https://github.com/pokelabshq/poke | Landing page + CLI |

### Micro-Services (12 total, all in `council/poke-services/`)
| Service | Port | Description |
|---------|------|-------------|
| link-preview | 8765 | Extract title, description, image from URLs |
| keyword | 8766 | Extract keywords and entities from text |
| summarize | 8767 | Extractive text summarization |
| qr | 8768 | Generate SVG QR codes |
| dns | 8769 | Query DNS records |
| portal | 8770 | Service portal/dashboard |
| color | 8771 | Generate color palettes |
| url | 8772 | URL shortener |
| template-gen | 8773 | Generate project templates |
| health-agg | 8774 | Aggregate health checks across services |
| json2ts | 8775 | Convert JSON to TypeScript interfaces |
| github-webhook | 8776 | GitHub webhook handler |

### Infrastructure
- **API Gateway** (port 8700) — reverse proxy routing to all services
- **Deploy script** (`deploy.sh`) — one-command deploy for all services
- **Test suite** — health check all services
- **Dependabot auto-merge** — automatic patch updates on council repo

### Frontend (poke repo)
- **Landing page** — "Poke — Your AI Employee That Never Sleeps"
- **Interactive API demo** — widget to try services from the browser (`feat/api-demo` branch)
- **Status page** — real-time service health dashboard (`feat/status-page` branch)
- **CLI tool** — `ai-council` terminal app with 5 AI personas (`feat/cli` branch)

### Documentation
- README.md for both repos
- PITCH.md investor pitch deck
- This WORKLOG.md
